advisories.component: std/algebra emulated scalar multiplication (fake-GLV); std/signature/ecdsa incl. P-256
advisories.summary: Fake-GLV scalar-multiplication hint result is not checked to be on the curve, which lets a prover forge ECDSA / P-256 verification in-circuit.
advisories.action: Upgrade to v0.16.4 or later, recompile every affected circuit and regenerate proving and verifying keys; redeploy any verifier contract built from the old keys.

advisories.component: std (emulated arithmetic, torus, GLV, uints lookups for SHA2/Keccak, pairing Miller loop, comb scalar mul)
advisories.summary: Eleven std-library issues where a hint output is consumed without a binding or range constraint (emulated carry not range-checked, unconstrained torus scale, unbound GLV sub-scalars, remainder vs runtime modulus, uints lookup key collision, Miller loop with Q = 0, comb top bit).
advisories.action: Upgrade to v0.16.2 or later (v0.16.4 also fixes GHSA-7fx8), recompile affected circuits and regenerate keys and verifier contracts.

advisories.component: std/algebra pairing G2 membership (IsOnTwist vs AssertIsOnTwist)
advisories.summary: A G2 subgroup / twist check is computed but its result is discarded, so points off the twist are accepted.
advisories.action: Upgrade past v0.15.0, recompile affected circuits and regenerate keys. Research notes give the fix as 'after v0.15.0'; confirm the exact version on the advisory page.

advisories.component: gnark-crypto Vector.ReadFrom (field-element vector deserialization, reached when gnark reads proofs, keys and witnesses)
advisories.summary: A 4-byte length read from untrusted input sizes an allocation without a bound, so a crafted proof or key can make a verifier or prover allocate up to 128 GB and crash.
advisories.action: Upgrade gnark-crypto to v0.18.1 (0.18 line) or v0.19.2 or later; never deserialize proofs, keys or witnesses from untrusted sources without a size limit. Circuits and keys are unaffected.
advisories.evidence: OSV record GHSA-fj2x-735w-74vq (two ranges) and GO-2025-4087.
